title: oxyacantha vulgaris
intro: Oxyacantha vulgaris, commonly known as Hawthorn, is a flowering plant in the rose family that has been used for centuries in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Hawthorn include reducing blood pressure, improving cardiovascular health, and enhancing digestion. The therapeutic actions of Hawthorn include vasodilation, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its cardiovascular and digestive benefits. The bioactive constituents of Hawthorn include flavonoids, such as quercetin and oligopeptides, as well as triterpenoids and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
